description: Integrity, compassion and justice guide and drive Amy’s service. She has a long and strong track record of supporting children, families, and communities in all types of communities - suburban, urban, and rural, big and small, those impacted by poverty and those that are not. Because of her own life experiences, Amy is committed to listening and to better understanding what you need as a member of our community.
